rows.grounds: past participle describing absence of prior placement
fused form: yat + tat + mānasūtraṃ; internal sandhi noted, token kept whole

items.question: Under what condition is the measuring cord to be prescribed in the ritual layout?
premises: A location may lack a previously placed measuring cord.
The measuring cord is the operative line for ritual measurement.
Ritual procedure requires explicit prescription for such cases.
items.inference: Wherever the measuring cord is absent, that measuring cord is to be prescribed there.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the absence depends on the preceding layout instructions in verses 673–674.
items.plain_english: Wherever it is lacking, that very measuring cord is to be laid down.
